svg.title: Part 3: measure the pipeline, then diagnose its weakest row
svg.desc: Twenty questions from the eval set run through the answer_question pipeline. Three evaluators score each answer: RetrievalEvaluator, GroundednessEvaluator, and RelevanceEvaluator. The evaluate function returns one row per question. Then you diagnose the row with the lowest retrieval score by re-running it with the state filter. The eval set and the pipeline are shown dashed as context.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
